claim: Repository is a Spring Boot service that evaluates JSON-defined rules against arbitrary input data via a REST API.
notes: pom.xml <description> and README opening paragraph agree on purpose.

claim: Project is a single-module Maven build on Spring Boot 3.2.5 / Java 17, using spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-validation, and jackson-databind.
notes: No submodules; groupId org.example, artifactId rule-engine-api, version 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.

claim: RuleEngineApplication is the Spring Boot application entrypoint (server process).
REST endpoint POST /api/v1/rule-engine/evaluate accepts {data, rule} and returns {result: boolean}.
notes: Controller delegates directly to RuleEngineService.evaluate with @Valid request body.

claim: RuleEngineService.evaluate recursively dispatches group rules (all/any/not) and array rules (implicit AND), delegating leaf nodes to evalCondition.
notes: Short-circuit evaluation implemented for both AND and OR groups.

claim: evalCondition implements operators eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, between, in, contains, regex, exists, not_exists, isNull, isNotNull; unrecognized enum values fall to a default branch that throws IllegalArgumentException.
notes: The switch has no 'case sin' so Operator.sin falls through to default and throws 'Operator not implemented: sin' at runtime.

claim: Operator.java (uncommitted working-tree change) adds a 'sin' enum constant with no corresponding case in RuleEngineService.evalCondition, and no test, controller doc, or README reference exists for it.
commands: git diff (shows added 'sin' enum constant, no other changes)
notes: Compiles successfully (enum addition alone does not break compilation) but would throw IllegalArgumentException('Operator not implemented: sin') if ever invoked. Working tree is not clean relative to commit 64b4948.

claim: Value comparison coerces both sides to BigDecimal when numeric, falls back to Instant.parse for ISO-8601 strings, then Comparable, then string comparison.
notes: README 'Type coercion rules' section documents the same behavior consistent with code.

claim: GlobalExceptionHandler maps IllegalArgumentException and MethodArgumentNotValidException both to HTTP 400 with a JSON body {error, message}.
notes: README claims 422 for validation errors but code returns 400 for MethodArgumentNotValidException; this is a documentation/code mismatch.
conflicts: README.md lines ~57-60 state 422 Unprocessable Entity for validation failures, but GlobalExceptionHandler returns 400 Bad Request for MethodArgumentNotValidException.

claim: src/main/java/org/example/Main.java is an IntelliJ scaffold/demo class unrelated to the Spring Boot application, printing a greeting and looping 1-5.
notes: Contains IDE TIP comments typical of IntelliJ new-project templates; not referenced by pom.xml mainClass, tests, or other code.

claim: RuleEngineControllerTest is a single @SpringBootTest + MockMvc test exercising the /evaluate endpoint end-to-end with one gte condition.
notes: Only one HTTP-level test case exists; no negative/error-path controller tests observed.

claim: RuleEngineServiceTest is a plain unit test (no Spring context) covering eq, gt+contains, any-group false, between+regex, exists/not_exists, isNull, and isNotNull.
notes: No tests observed for ne, lt, lte, gte alone, in, not group, malformed rule error paths, or the new 'sin' operator.

claim: The current working tree (including the uncommitted Operator.java change) compiles successfully offline via Maven.
notes: Only `compile` was run, not `test`; test execution/results are not claimed here.
